focus: Gene editing, molecular biology, trait discovery, functional genomics, bioinformatics, controlled environment studies.
note: Intervenes at the molecular and trait level, evaluated in controlled environments and laboratories where field output is not the endpoint.

focus: Genomic selection, breeding pipelines, varietal improvement, multi-location trials, seed readiness.
note: Intervenes on germplasm, evaluated at trial level.

focus: Multiplication, adaptive testing, varietal dissemination, distribution networks.
note: Intervenes through varieties reaching farmers' fields.

focus: Advisory systems, interoperability, AI/LLM platforms, digital extension.
note: Intervenes on farmer decisions at farm level; reports on outcome/impact indicators only where it operates its own ground measurement.

focus: Regenerative agriculture, conservation agriculture, nutrient management, water management.
note: A focused delivery intervention, service delivery model or implementation mechanism, intervening on management at trial and farm level. Smaller in scope than a full Hub Model.

focus: Agri-food system transformation, rural innovation hubs, livelihoods, climate resilience, policy integration, employment ecosystems.
note: The most integrated systems-level intervention: potentially multiple services, actors, geographies and delivery pathways, intervening at farm level across every thread of a pathway.
